conviction_note: Ministop's own 月次 already show the Jun-Aug quarter falling far short of last year's +1,116m operating profit (Jun -8.4%, Jul -4.5%, Aug -3.6% 既存店; chain sales -9% for H1). That miss is public, and IFIS (FY OP -800m against the company's +1,500m) already doubts the plan. So the only thing the release can add is the forecast decision. The company has held its plan at H1 in each of the last three years and cut in January or March instead. The margin side is net short (信用倍率 0.27). Together that leaves a slight negative lean: p_up 48 on a 2.8% scale. The findings sum (-0.60) is larger than the scaled number (-0.11) because each finding carries its full size if the cut lands, while p_up weighs the more likely outcome, a held plan with nothing new.
bar: IFIS consensus FY2027/2 (2026-07-07): revenue 94,500m, operating profit -800m, ordinary -300m, net -1,150m. Company plan: revenue 97,000m, operating profit 1,500m, ordinary 1,900m, held at Q1. Sources: https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/9946_20260708_act_20260708_153023_4 and https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9946. One estimate source, dated before Q1, so it is stale and every finding is capped small. print_vs_bar_pct is on revenue: revenue grows because franchise stores are being converted to company-run stores (直営 +27% in Q1), and the miss sits in profit, not revenue.
positioning_check: JPX short register: no disclosed position at or above 0.5% (as of 2026-09-29, unchanged from the prior reading, baseline source https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 0.27, so margin shorts outnumber margin longs about 3.7 to 1. The baseline carries this from a broker scrape, and kabutan's quote panel (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9946&b=n202610071041, read 2026-10-08 10:13 JST) also shows 0.27. Leveraged retail is not crowded long, which is the one setup in which a visible miss would still have sellers. There is no option skew in Japan. priced_lean_pct is +0.348, mostly the margin component. Run-up: -1.28% over 20 days, -0.78% over 5. The stock sits at 1,773, near its 2026 lows (1,767 on 2026-03-04, 1,750 on 2026-06-19).

findings.finding: The company's own 月次 put Q2 (Jun-Aug 2026) domestic sales well below last year's profitable quarter. 既存店 daily sales: Jun -8.4%, Jul -4.5%, Aug -3.6%. Customer count Aug -5.2%. H1 cumulative 既存店 94.8% and all-store sales 91.0%, with in-store fast food (the high-margin line) at 80.9% cumulative. In Q1 a 7.3% chain-sales fall already cut gross profit by 751m while SG&A rose 1,266m (ads +481m, personnel +513m as franchise stores moved to 直営). So H1 operating profit most likely swings from +1,116m last year to a loss of roughly -2 to -3bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2025 (released 2025-10-08 15:30): operating profit turned positive with 90%+ of the FY plan reached, and the stock rose 8.23% the next day (kabutan https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9946&b=n202510090248). Q1 2026 (operating loss -2,015m against 0, plan held): the stock moved -0.76% / -0.44%. MINKABU wrote that few read the quarter negatively (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9946&b=n202607090430).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly it is priced. The 月次 are public, IFIS has FY operating profit at -800m against the company's +1,500m, and the stock sits near its year low after a flat 20 days. What is left unpriced is how deep the Q2 loss is, because higher costs from the 直営 conversion do not show in the sales series. With margin shorts outnumbering longs 3.7 to 1, few leveraged longs are left to sell a known miss, and 悪材料出尽くし is possible. Sized small for both reasons.
findings.independence: Q1 cost structure from the company's 第1四半期決算短信補足 (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/99460/140120260707588782.pdf). Jun/Jul 2026 monthly figures confirmed in trade press: https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/s081776.html (2026-08-17). Same company data, so not truly independent.

findings.finding: Forecast decision. Full-year operating profit guidance of +1,500m (ordinary +1,900m) sits 2.3bn above the July IFIS consensus of -800m. A likely H1 loss of about -2 to -3bn would require roughly +4bn in H2, against -4.7bn in H2 last year. The company's own record is to hold at H1 and revise in Q3 or at year end (revisions on 2024-03-22, 2025-01-10 and 2026-01-08, none at an H1 print). So a hold is the modal outcome. A cut, if it comes now, probably lands below the stale July consensus, because the street has not updated since Q1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last forecast cut, from ordinary +1,600m to -3,000m, came with Q3 on 2026-01-08 at 14:00 JST. The stock fell 4.77% that session and recovered 3.33% the next, about -1.6% net. At the H1 2025 print the plan was held and the stock rose 8.23%, on a strong quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether the company cuts now or waits until January is not knowable from public data, and a cut at H1 would break its own three-year habit. If the market expected a cut below consensus, the stock would have sold off into the print with disclosed shorts building. Instead the short register shows zero, margin shorts outnumber longs, and the stock has drifted only 1.3% over 20 days. Expected value is small and negative: the hold that is most likely adds nothing, and a cut would cost about 2-3%.
findings.independence: IFIS consensus and the company plan: https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/9946_20260708_act_20260708_153023_4 (2026-07-08). Pattern of the January cut: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9946&b=k202601080005 (2026-01-08).

findings.finding: Domestic stores fell from 1,818 (June 2025) to 1,722 (August 2026), with 39 closures in Q1 alone. Q1 booked 336m of store-closure losses and 64m of impairment as extraordinary items. H1 will carry more closure and impairment charges below operating profit, which widens the net loss and keeps eroding equity (equity ratio 38.3% to 32.0% in Q1).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No separable reaction found. FY2025/2's -4.9bn Q4 net loss, driven by extraordinary items, came at the 2025-04-10 print, and the estimated-cadence move was +4.49%.
findings.why_not_priced: Below operating profit, with no path to the guide. Store-count declines appear in every 月次, so the item is largely known, and it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: Store counts in the 月次 (https://www.ministop.co.jp/corporate/ir/finance/results/) and in ryutsuu (https://www.ryutsuu.biz/sales/r071176.html, 2025-07-10, for the 1,818 base).

outside_window.finding: The most likely timing for a full-year forecast cut is Q3 (early January 2027), following the company's own pattern of revisions on 2025-01-10 and 2026-01-08.

baseline_tension: The strongest positive the release could carry is the modal outcome: a held full-year plan with the interim dividend maintained. Against a margin book net short 3.7 to 1 and a stock near its year low, that could produce 悪材料出尽くし, and the H1 2025 print was bought +8.2%. I searched for buybacks, dividend or 優待 changes and Aeon tender-offer news and found none. My lean is negative, slightly against priced_lean (+0.35) and in line with the soft run-up (-1.3%), and it is kept small for that reason.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次): finding 1 cut from -0.3 to -0.15. The quarter's miss is in a public series and in an IFIS figure far below the plan.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): I wrote down the strongest positive (a held plan plus maintained dividend, possible 悪材料出尽くし) and confirmed I had looked for returns, 優待 and tender offers. Finding 2 trimmed from -0.5 to -0.4 because a hold is the modal outcome. p_up moved from 47 to 48.
Finding 3 (one-off) trimmed from -0.1 to -0.05 as below operating profit and visible in store counts. abs_move_pct unchanged at 2.8.
